ScrollAssembly.chapters.0.label: ROOTED
ScrollAssembly.chapters.0.title:
Built here.
Here to stay.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.0.description: Yellostack is a Saudi company, founded in Al Khobar in 2017. Every project we take on is designed and built in the Kingdom by a team that understands your market, your language and your regulations. When you need us, we’re down the road, not a time zone away.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.1.label: BUILT
ScrollAssembly.chapters.1.title:
One team.
Every layer of your product.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.1.description: Brand, UI/UX, web, mobile, AI and custom software, all under one roof. You get no hand-offs between agencies, no finger-pointing and no gaps between what was designed and what was delivered. The same people own it from the first sketch to go-live.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.2.label: PROMISED
ScrollAssembly.chapters.2.title:
On time.
Or it costs us.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.2.description: We stand behind our timelines with a written commitment: if we don’t deliver within the agreed time frame, we waive 20% of the project cost. Our promises are contractual, not just in our marketing.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.3.label: ONE STACK
ScrollAssembly.chapters.3.title:
Rooted. Built. Promised.
That’s Yellostack.
ScrollAssembly.chapters.3.description: A local partner with the team to build it all and the confidence to guarantee it. Tell us what you’re building next, and we’ll show you how we’d stack it.

profile.summary: YelloStack is a Saudi Arabia-based technology company combining AI, software engineering and intelligent automation to turn business ideas into practical digital products. Our engineers, designers and technology specialists work closely with your team to improve efficiency, accuracy and business performance.
profile.mission.title: Our mission
profile.mission.body: To build innovative, secure, and cost-effective technology solutions from Saudi Arabia for businesses worldwide. Through Artificial Intelligence, software development, mobile applications, healthcare technology, and intelligent automation, we aim to solve real-world challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and create lasting business value while contributing to the growth of Saudi Arabia’s digital ecosystem.
profile.vision.title: Our vision
profile.vision.body: To become a leading Saudi technology company driving the future of AI-powered innovation, developing intelligent digital solutions that empower businesses, accelerate digital transformation, and contribute to Saudi Arabia’s vision of a technology-driven economy.
